literal: Virtue having known, not-coveting wise-possessors will reach, the way having known, right there, prosperity.
translation: Prosperity will know the way and go straight to the wise who know virtue and do not covet.
modern: அறத்தை அறிந்து பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பாத அறிவுடையவர்களை, செல்வம் தானே வழியறிந்து சென்று சேரும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the natural reward of a virtuous, non-covetous mind. The wise understand what is right and therefore refrain from desiring the property of others. Because of this pure wisdom, true prosperity actively seeks them out. It knows the proper way to reach such deserving individuals directly. The imagery personifies wealth as an entity that chooses its rightful, ungreedy owner.
